rationale: Claude is a frontier coding-agent family.
Open-weight GPT models are coding-capable; safety-only variants are excluded.
GPT coding models are included; image and audio modalities are excluded.
OpenAI o1 reasoning models are coding-capable.
OpenAI o3 reasoning models are coding-capable.
OpenAI o4 reasoning models are coding-capable.
Gemini is a frontier coding family; image-only variants are excluded.
DeepSeek V-series and R-series models are coding and reasoning candidates; vision variants are excluded.
Qwen and Qwen Coder are coding-capable; vision-language variants are excluded.
Codestral is a dedicated code-model family.
Devstral is a dedicated agentic coding-model family.
Mistral instruction models are general-purpose coding candidates.
Ministral is Mistral's smaller instruction-model line and is coding-capable.
Mixtral instruction models are open-weight coding candidates.
Llama instruct models are coding-capable; guard and safety variants are excluded.
Gemma instruction models are open-weight coding candidates.
Phi instruction models are small coding-capable candidates.
Granite instruction and code models are coding candidates.
GLM coding and reasoning models are included; known vision variants are excluded.
Kimi reasoning and code variants are coding candidates.
MiniMax reasoning models are coding candidates.
Seed 2.0 Code is explicitly a code model.
KAT-Coder is explicitly a coding-model family.
Relace Apply is a dedicated code-editing model.
Morph models are designed for coding-agent editing.
Poolside Laguna is a coding-model family.
Grok is a general-purpose coding candidate; build-only experimental variants are excluded.
